// Fixture: calls whose functions are not imported here use the event shapes: say(g, x, title, text, log) and notice(g, title, text).
export function loose(g: GameState, x: Ctx): void {
  say(g, x, 'Nobody Said Much', 'Nobody said a word on the way home.', 'I walked home. Mostly.')
  notice(g, 'Nobody Knew That', `Nobody knew ${g.character.name} in ${town ?? `the ${g.year} fair`}.`)
  const card = ch('card', 'Nobody sends cards', '\u{1F48C}')
  chat.say(g, x, 'Nobody Replied Here', 'Nobody replied to the note.')
  notice(g, 'Nobody Paid Up', `Nobody pays \${5} but ${g.price} is due.`)
}
